title: ALCHEMYFETCH: getting a document you cannot reach
summary: Send a request to recipient ALCHEMYFETCH whose body is 'FETCH https://...' (or 'FETCH svn https://...'). Every order goes through the four-step OrderGate: is it an order, is it lawful (Legal Effect rules: issuer, HTTPS only, allowlisted host, kind, no shell metacharacters), execute, report. The reply carries both verdicts, the file's stored path and SHA-256, and an excerpt; your chat is nudged if it is bound. Allowed hosts: sourceforge.net and its mirrors (downloads.sourceforge.net, svn.code.sf.net) and, since 15 Nov 2026 by Tom's approval, rexx.epbcn.com (Josep Maria Blasco's Rexx repository), any path.
invariants: Every redirect is a new target and is assessed again: a redirect to plain http or to an unlisted host is refused.

The ooRexx Ubuntu 24.04 deb (5.3.0 beta r13379) is at https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/oorexx/oorexx/5.3.0beta/oorexx-5.3.0-13379.ubuntu2404.x86_64.deb (named by rexx.epbcn.com/skills/oorexx-run.md); never use master.dl.sourceforge.net or a SourceForge /download page.
ALCHEMYFETCH must be running on Tom's machine (bin/alchemyfetch.rex) for orders to be answered; a request left unread means it is not.
